mapper.insert: insert into account_user_imports (id, file_hash, row_count, valid, rows_json, status, expires_at, created_by, created_at) values (#{batch.id}, #{batch.fileHash}, #{batch.rowCount}, #{batch.valid}, #{batch.rowsJson}, #{batch.status}, #{batch.expiresAt}, #{batch.createdBy}, #{batch.createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, file_hash, row_count, valid, rows_json, result_json, status, expires_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from account_user_imports where id = #{id} and created_by = #{operatorId} for update
mapper.update: update account_user_imports set status = 'committed', rows_json = null, result_json = #{batch.resultJson}, expires_at = #{batch.expiresAt}, updated_by = #{batch.updatedBy}, updated_at = #{batch.updatedAt} where id = #{batch.id} and created_by = #{batch.createdBy} and status = 'preview'
mapper.select: select id from account_user_imports where expires_at <= #{now} order by expires_at, id limit 100
mapper.delete: delete from account_user_imports where expires_at <= #{now} and id in #{id}
